seo.h1: M-200 Titanium Dioxide for Exterior Plastics and Masterbatch Evaluation

hero.summaryLead: A chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment treated with silica, alumina and organic compounds, documented for exterior plastic products, PVC calendered films and durable plastic masterbatch.
hero.summaryBody: The M-200 profile identifies durability, processing rheology, dry-powder conveying, compatibility, dispersibility, color fastness and anti-chalking performance as evaluation priorities. Review the typical data and confirm suitability in your own polymer, formulation, processing, exposure and end-use conditions.

positioning.heading: Where M-200 Fits in Product Evaluation
positioning.lead: M-200 is a chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment treated with silica, alumina and organic compounds for exterior-plastics and masterbatch evaluation.
positioning.body: Use M-200 as a candidate when durability, processing behavior, powder conveying, compatibility, dispersion, color fastness and anti-chalking behavior are relevant. Final selection should account for polymer, carrier resin, additives, pigment loading, processing temperature, equipment, exposure conditions, appearance and destination documents.
decisionPoints: PVC profile, plate, furniture and calendered-film directions
Evaluation of durability, processing, compatibility, dispersion, color fastness and anti-chalking behavior

applications.heading: Exterior Plastics and Masterbatch Directions to Evaluate
applications.intro: Review each documented direction in your own polymer system, processing, exposure and end-use conditions.

items.title: uPVC Profiles, Plates and Exterior Furniture
items.body: Evaluate M-200 in the intended uPVC or exterior-plastic system. Confirm dispersion, appearance, processing behavior, outdoor-performance requirements and end-use suitability.

items.title: PVC Calendered Films, Including Advertising Film
items.body: Test M-200 at the intended pigment loading, formulation and calendering conditions. Review compatibility, dispersion, color, processing behavior and finished-film performance.

items.title: Durable Plastic Masterbatch
items.body: Evaluate M-200 in the selected carrier resin and dilution system. Confirm powder handling, dispersion, color development, processing and performance in the final plastic application.
